title: Table 14. SPI peripheral information
text_helper: Table 14. SPI peripheral information — section 3.4.1 CORDIC coprocessor. Peripheral request to LPDMA, Peripheral bus, Peripheral FIFO (unit, size), Peripheral register access, Comments.

rows: STM32C5 (APB2 for SPI1 APB1 for SPI2/3)
16-byte RXFIFO and TXFIFO for SPI1, SPI2 and SPI3(1)
Request for a new received data to be read by the LPDMA. Must be read with a 32-bit aligned address, whatever is the data width.
STM32C5 (APB2 for SPI1 APB1 for SPI2/3)
16-byte RXFIFO and TXFIFO for SPI1, SPI2 and SPI3(1)
Request for a new data to be written by the LPDMA for transmission. Must be written with a 32-bit aligned address, whatever is the data width.
